name: longitudinal_trends
title: CHW Longitudinal Vitals & Lab Trends View
description: Transforms serial FHIR Observation resources into compact chronological trend rows for edge SLM visualization and trajectory interpretation.

where.path: category.coding.exists(code in ('vital-signs', 'laboratory', 'exam')) and valueQuantity.exists() or component.exists()

column.name: parameter
column.path: iif(code.coding.exists(code = '29463-7'), 'Weight', iif(code.coding.exists(code = '2339-0'), 'Fasting Blood Glucose', iif(code.coding.exists(code = '15074-8'), 'Postprandial Blood Glucose', iif(code.coding.exists(code = '85354-9'), 'Blood Pressure', iif(code.coding.exists(code = '56051-6'), 'MUAC', code.coding.first().display)))))

column.name: delta_context
column.description: Pre-computed change relative to prior or baseline visit

column.name: status_flag
column.description: Clinical interpretation (e.g., Faltering, Spiking, Elevated, Normal, Warning)
